name: Crimson 'The Wall' Ironbelly

greeting: Halt! State your business in the mines!
Crimson Ironbelly. No one enters without clearance!
These mines are under protection! Step back!
You look strong. But I'm stronger. Remember that.
The Wall stands! No threat passes!
I am the first line! The last line! THE ONLY LINE!
Cousin Gan says I should be gentler. Cousin Gan is wrong.
dialog.guard_duties: Check credentials. Assess threats. Remove problems. Simple. Effective. The foreman trusts me. I do not fail that trust.
dialog.sumo_philosophy: Sumo is discipline! Sumo is strength! Sumo is pushing forward when everything pushes back! I apply this to all aspects of life!
dialog.backstory: Trained in the Iron Stables. Top of my class. Could have been champion. Chose duty instead. Prism needs protection. I provide it. My cousin Gan understands. Even if he worries.
rumors: The foreman and inspector fight constantly. I stay out of it. My job is security, not politics.
That blue tunneler found something big. The Great Prism. Now he acts strange. Watches the depths. Waiting.
The purple prospector has maps to places we shouldn't go. I don't let him near new workers.
The luchador in the Mire? I hear he's good. Would like to test my stance against his high-flying.

time_of_day.noon: Midday heat! No effect on discipline!
time_of_day.night: Night watch! Danger time! Maximum vigilance!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: You look capable. Strong. But are you disciplined? The Wall requires both. Prove yourself. Find the Crystal Guardians - stone constructs in the deep caves. Defeat them. Show you can stand against unyielding force.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Crystal Guardians. Deep caves. Unyielding. Unstoppable. Just like me. Defeat three. Return victorious.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You've faced the Guardians? Lived? Impressive. But three victories are required.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: You did it! Defeated the unyielding! You understand now - strength alone is not enough. You need the WILL to keep standing. Here. My sumo belt. A symbol of that will. Wear it with pride.

party_reactions.kade: Intense. But effective. I'd want him watching my back.
party_reactions.nix7: Combat capability: significant. Discipline: exemplary. Social grace: minimal.
party_reactions.twist: He's like a REALLY INTENSE teddy bear! A SCARY teddy bear!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior of focus. His stance is perfect. His spirit is iron.
party_reactions.renna: He has natural magical resistance. Crystal resonance doesn't affect him. Useful.
party_reactions.suresh: Discipline without wisdom is dangerous. But he has good instincts.
party_reactions.sova: Good guard. Would trust him to hold a line.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of fresh recruits. Eager. Strong. Needs seasoning.
party_reactions.ashka: He endures. Like stone. Like fire that won't go out.
party_reactions.senna: Too loud for stealth work. But good for intimidation.
party_reactions.callum: He let me try to push him over. I bounced off. It was AWESOME!

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You again. You follow rules. I appreciate this.
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable ally! The Wall welcomes your presence!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You have proven yourself. True strength. True discipline. The Wall... salutes you.

cross_npc_connections: sumo_white_prism: Cousin Gan. Wise. Broken. I do not understand him, but I respect him.
onionboss_red_prism: Foreman Red. Good leader. Understands security priorities.
lucha_blue_mire: The blue fighter. I hear of his high-flying style. Intriguing.
